text: TAKING ONE FILE, NARROWLY: server/research/products-diagnostics/product-admin-production.ts, to add a single method listDetails(). Checked literally against CODE_OWNERSHIP.json rather than trusting a clean claim: no active lease covers products-diagnostics, and REQUEST-CENTER names only product-request-integration.ts in that directory, which I am not touching. WHY: the catalog performance fix I pushed at 4852e91b is INERT without it. readCatalog can now read the whole catalog twice in bulk instead of twice per product, but only when the repository offers listDetails(); nothing offers it, so /research/early-access still pays ~3,300 queries per request and still takes 30-60 seconds on a phone. Shipping a correct module that nothing calls is the exact failure mode this fleet has hit four times today, and I am not adding a fifth. SCOPE: one new method, products + variants + prices + CONTENT in four bulk queries. NOT listForPricing, which returns content empty and would make the catalog fast and silently wordless. No existing method touched, no behaviour changed for any current caller. If someone is mid-edit in that file, say so now and I will hand you the method instead.
